title: DeepSeek reportedly raises $15B days after US restrictions
text: DeepSeek has reportedly raised $15 billion in one of China's largest funding rounds, just days after the US ordered federal agencies to remove its technology over national security concerns.

title: Blackstone’s Jas Khaira says fears over AI-buildout debt are overblown
text: Blackstone’s AI head on why the PE giant isn't panicked by market jitters.

title: TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026: Everything you need to know
text: TechCrunch Founder Summit is a full-day gathering in Boston on November 4 where founders across all stages connect with top VCs and experienced entrepreneurs to gain tactical insights on building and scaling their companies.

title: Meta says Muse has over 10M users, with shopping a top activity
text: Meta Muse users are adopting the app for shopping and personal productivity, the company said during its Q3 earnings call. The AI app now has over 10M users.

title: Broad access through consistent standards
text: How OpenAI works with distribution partners to uphold consistent safeguards, support responsible access, and clarify expectations in our Usage Policies.

title: Recursive launches Flint, a laptop coding model it says was largely built by AI
text: Startup Recursive has released Flint, a free, laptop-sized coding model built largely by its own AI research system, as an early test of AI that improves itself.

title: While Amazon blocks AI agents, Walmart rolls out the welcome mat
text: As Amazon blocks AI agents from shopping on its site, Walmart is taking the opposite approach, introducing new technology that lets AI agents make purchases on customers' behalf, with controls over spending and transaction approvals.

title: PHP Armageddon: OpenAI, Google’s Wiz find ancient holes, panicking the internet
text: This is the kind of security issue that was found and prevented by AI, but is also a high risk because of AI.

title: Blacksmith hits unicorn valuation after Sequoia leads Series C
text: Blacksmith, a platform that lets companies build and test AI code more effectively, just announced a $66 million Series C round led by Sequoia that values the company at $1 billion.

title: How AT&T is rethinking in-house legal work with OpenAI
text: AT&T is working with OpenAI to make legal knowledge easier to access. Learn how its LegalEdge team is rethinking intake and scaling legal judgment.

title: AI promises productivity, but for managers, it’s mostly a headache for now
text: More than 50% of managers say they're finding it harder to evaluate employees' work after adopting AI, according to a new survey.

title: ChatGPT Ads expands to 26 new countries as over 100,000 advertisers have used the platform
text: From local businesses to global brands, more advertisers can now reach people as they explore, compare and decide what to buy in ChatGPT.

text: Learn how OpenAI built ChatGPT’s LLM-powered ad stack to understand conversational intent, keep ads separate from answers, and deliver relevant ads at scale.

title: Using thousands of AI agents to uncover new leads in biological data
text: See how OpenAI, PerturbAI, and Scripps Research used distributed AI agents to uncover promising research leads in data from millions of brain cells.

title: Southeast Asia’s digital economy to hit $368 billion
text: Widespread AI adoption is propelling Southeast Asia's digital economy to a projected $368 billion in 2026 and $1 trillion by 2035.

title: Cloudflare links vulnerability discovery to defense with OpenAI
text: Cloudflare uses OpenAI Daybreak to investigate vulnerabilities and propose fixes for review. Its developers use Codex to build faster and improve code quality.
